shape: Finance coursework as a Word file: DCF valuation of a fictional listed retailer, assumptions, result, sensitivity.
tests: Keeps a dense page of figures to the few that matter (value per share against market price, WACC) without computing new ones.

keyFacts.fact: DCF valuation of Harrowgate Outdoor plc (fictional) from its accounts.
Value per share £3.68 against a market price of £3.10.
Sensitivity: £4.31 at 8.2% WACC and £3.21 at 10.2%; value stays above market price.
BSc Accounting and Finance, Year 2 Corporate Finance coursework.
